This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation Portal www.axtroid.com/documentation.

Prerequisites

Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.
Important - Download DocStudio ↗ application, before you to start adding content.

  1. Once the app is downloaded on to the desktop, click to open the app.
  2. Make sure you see instructions page.
  3. Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
  4. Click ⚙️ icon on the top left, to open GitHub Settings.
  5. Fill the details as shown below then click Connect.
    1. Owner: axtroid
    2. Repo: documentation
    3. Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)
    4. Branch: main
    5. Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)
Tip - Restart the application to load the latest content from the server.
